pinned_version: 8.5.1 (CHANGES.md says released 2026-11-09; GitHub releases page shows 06 Nov)

changes_after_pin.title: Deprecate bad parameter names (#3866)
changes_after_pin.summary: Names that aren't valid identifiers or are keywords are deprecated (TypeError in 9.0). Non-lowercase identifier-style option names are also deprecated.

changes_after_pin.title: Add Parameter.spec, deprecate human_readable_name (#3877)
changes_after_pin.summary: New Parameter.spec property shows how users type the parameter. get_help_spec moves from Option to Parameter, and Argument overrides it to return its metavar. Errors and warnings show the spec. human_readable_name is deprecated and its return value changes.

changes_after_pin.title: CliRunner echoes ^D and ^Z (#3878)
changes_after_pin.summary: With echo_stdin=True, CliRunner echoes \x04 and \x1a as ^D and ^Z and no longer passes them to the command.

changes_after_pin.title: Help pages no longer break within hyphenated or long words (#3902)
Docs and CI changes (#3917, #3918, #3897, #3898, #3909)
changes_after_pin.summary: catch_exceptions testing docs, file-object parameter docs, Nuitka standalone guide, Click UI scope/direction doc, and Python 3.15 added to the test matrix.

open_or_planned.title: #2784 Allow adding dynamic parameters to every Context
#3880 Split PAGER and EDITOR with a Windows-specific shlex equivalent
#3827 Require parameter name to be a non-keyword identifier
open_or_planned.summary: Open PR. Overlaps with the merged deprecation in #3866.

open_or_planned.title: #3859 and #3412 Add pyrefly type checking
open_or_planned.summary: Two overlapping open PRs. Tooling only.

Python 3.10 drop and Python 3.15 test matrix
